dct_title_s: Satellite detected mudflow as of 2 November 2026 in Gasa and Punakha Districts, Bhutan
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20261030BTN** This map illustrates cumulative satellite-detected flood waters and/or mudflow derived from KANOPUS-V and RESOURCESAT-2 acquired imagery acquired on 1st November 2026 and Pleiades imagery acquired on 2nd November 2026. Within the cloud free analyzed areas of about 1,240 km², a total of about 9 km² of lands appear to be affected with flood waters and/or mudflow. The analysis indicates that about 81 buildings have been damaged or possibly affected by the water and/or mudflow as well as approximatively 4 km of roads were affected. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre.
